column1: # akantu-rs project tooling: the verdict of every run of the ParaView visual
# check, written by hand after the causes were read in both sources
# (the report explains each). make_report.py puts them in
# the report's summary table next to the measured file counts.
# Columns (tab separated): id (cases.tsv, or py-<case> of python-cases.tsv) |
# verdict: identical | compat (identical with upstream's behaviour switched on:
# the default corrects a defect, --upstream-compat gives upstream's bytes) |
# differs (no setting of the port gives upstream's file: the port's file is
# the corrected one) | gap (the port cannot do what upstream does) | port-only |
# cause, with the defect entries of docs/UPSTREAM_DEFECTS.md (- = none).
